figures.title: Class-invariant directions
figures.caption: Class-invariant directions and model responses. (a) A class-invariant direction $v$ and a class-relevant direction $u$ near input $x$. (b) True conditional class-probability contours in the local $u,v$ plane of a binary task. Direction $v$ is tangent to a contour at $x$, satisfying $D_v\eta(x)=0$. (c) Model probability contours in the same plane. Predictions can have a non-zero first-order change along $v$.

figures.title: Initialization and warm-up
figures.caption: Uniform-target warm-up changes initial states and subsequent calibration. (a,b) Maximum predicted class probabilities before and after warm-up for one model; $\bar c$ is mean confidence over the displayed space. (c,d) Mean pointwise confidence bias and local response across 30 paired initializations. Grey points and lines show individual pairs; black open markers show the arithmetic mean in c and geometric mean response norm in d (logarithmic axis). (e) CIFAR-100 validation ECE: lines and shading show means and min--max ranges across the first three archived initializations. (f) Reliability diagram pooling their final test predictions. Selection rules and complete results are given in Methods and Supplementary Note S2.

figures.title: Directional coverage
figures.caption: Directional warm-up coverage and local responses during training. (a) Eight-dimensional binary-task geometry: $u$ is class-relevant and $v,w$ are class-invariant; class overlap is omitted and dashed lines mark Bayes decision-boundary sections. (b) Analytic Gaussian densities in the $v$--$w$ plane with equal covariance eigenvalues and larger variance along $w$ (top) or $v$ (bottom). (c) Post-warm-up squared response norms $R$ along $w$ (left) and $v$ (right). Small markers denote seeds and lines join paired conditions; large open markers and error bars show geometric means and 95\% paired bootstrap intervals. (d) Responses along $v$ during supervised training; lines and shading show geometric means and pointwise 95\% paired bootstrap intervals. Panels c,d use 100 paired initializations and logarithmic axes for $R+\epsilon$ ($\epsilon=10^{-12}$). See Methods and Supplementary Note S2.

figures.title: Optical noise domains
figures.caption: Image-noise statistics and relative warm-up calibration performance. Left, UC Merced imagery and illustrative Gaussian and LogGamma noise densities ($L=0.15$ for LogGamma; experiments used $L=4$). Right, EuroSAT test ECE for Gaussian warm-up and GW in each noise domain. Bars and error bars show means and two-sided 95\% $t$ confidence intervals across ten paired initializations. Input construction and cross-domain comparisons are described in Methods and Supplementary Note S3.

figures.title: GW workflow
figures.caption: Statistics estimation, input construction and training in GW. Relative intensity fluctuations from approximately homogeneous training-image regions guide distribution fitting and construction of the statistics-guided component. Each input retains a Gaussian base, with the statistics-guided component added at a specified probability and strength. Uniform-target warm-up precedes supervised learning on labelled data. The statistics-guided component is schematic.

figures.title: Local distribution fits
figures.caption: Local fluctuation fits and calibration of the corresponding warm-up constructions. Left, a representative approximately homogeneous OpenSARShip2 region and its magnification. Middle, empirical relative intensities and fitted candidate distributions. Right, mean ECE across five paired runs; error bars show sample standard deviations. Input construction and complete results are given in Methods and Supplementary Note S4.
